desc:
Welcome to BIKE FOR BRAINROTS🚲🧠

1. Ride into enemy bases and steal a Brainrot before they notice 🤫
2. Escape fast while brainrot chases you down 🏃‍♂️💨
3. Bring it back to your base and start earning cash 💵

Stack more Brainrots to grow your income faster 📈
Your Brainrots keep earning even when you are offline 💤

Having fun? 👍 Like the game and invite your friends to ride with you 😄
